name: weekly-gdpr-erasure-audit
description: Weekly GDPR Art. 17 erasure request audit — verifies all pending erasure requests were fully cascaded.
prompt: Query gdpr_erasure_requests table for requests completed in the last 7 days. Verify each request was cascaded to all subprocessors: PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Stripe, Auth0. Flag any incomplete cascades. Generate weekly GDPR erasure audit report.
